title: Service Level Statement: Support and Statement Entitlements of the Personal Sender Account
content:
Each verification level of the Personal Sender Account carries a set of service entitlements: the support line the customer is served on, whether a named relationship manager is assigned, the callback time, and the account statement entitlements — how far back a statement's transaction history may reach, how many statements may be requested in a rolling 12 months, and the statement delivery time.

## Support entitlements

| Level | Priority (dedicated) support line | Named relationship manager | Callback time (Paloma business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | no | no | 3 |
| Paloma Verified | no | no | 3 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | no | no | 2 |
| Paloma Enhanced | no | no | 2 |
| Paloma Premier | yes | no | 1 |
| Paloma Private Client | yes | yes | 1 |

## Statement entitlements

| Level | Statement history (calendar months of transaction history a statement may cover) | Statements that may be requested in any rolling 12 months | Statement delivery time (Paloma business days) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 12 | 2 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified | 24 | 4 | 3 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 24 | 6 | 2 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 36 | 6 | 2 |
| Paloma Premier | 60 | 12 | 1 |
| Paloma Private Client | 84 | 12 | 1 |

Paloma business days run Monday to Friday, excluding US Federal Reserve holidays.

## Points of reading

- **Statement history** is the reach of a statement into the past: at Paloma Starter a statement may cover up to 12 calendar months of history, at Paloma Enhanced up to 36, at Paloma Private Client up to 84.
- **Statements per rolling 12 months** caps how many statements may be requested; further requests wait until the window frees.
- Only Paloma Premier and Paloma Private Client are served on the priority line, and only Paloma Private Client has a named relationship manager.
- Hypothetical reading: a customer at Paloma Verified Plus has a callback time of 2 business days, may request up to 6 statements in a rolling 12 months, and each statement may reach back up to 24 calendar months.
